description:
Keyword opportunities from a keyword research run that a user started in the app (Keywords → Keyword research): Google Ads keyword ideas for seed keywords, a page URL or a whole (competitor) domain, each with its average monthly searches, competition and top-of-page bids in EUR, next to the property's own Google Search Console presence over the 90 days before the run (ranking, average position, clicks). gap_only (default true) keeps the ideas the property does not rank for — the content gap. Reads stored runs only: it never runs a new search; with no run, start one in the app. Defaults to the newest finished run; pass run_id for another one. Sorted by search volume, most first. search_volume.value is null when Google has no data (state no_data), never 0. Errors: no_research_run when the property has no finished run yet (start one in the app: Keywords → Keyword research), run_not_found for a run_id of another property. Pass property ID or sc-domain URL from list_properties.

Cost: 5 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// Competitor content gap: ideas with 1,000+ monthly searches the property does not rank for.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","minVolume":1000}
```

competition.description: Google Ads competition levels to keep.

gapOnly.description: Keep only ideas the property does not rank for in Search Console (default true).

runId.description: A research run id; omit for the newest finished run of the property.

name: find_keyword_opportunities

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor to fetch the next page; null on the last page.

render_with.description: Render tool that can display this payload.

title: Keyword opportunities
